summary: CRITICAL REGRESSION found from the 'White-on-Ice' restyle. Dashboard.jsx crashes at first render with `ReferenceError: lists is not defined` (line 79), which blocks the entire authenticated app: after login the dashboard is replaced by the React runtime-error overlay and direct navigation to /bids, /execution, /settings, /orcamento/:id all render blank (the broken root + dev error overlay prevent any route from mounting visibly). CSS/tokens themselves compiled correctly — body bg = #f6faff ice, primary button bg = rgb(20,22,26) Deep Charcoal, Hanken Grotesk font loads — so the visual restyle is fine, but the JSX edit that introduced the colored portal pill on the Today Alerts card referenced `lists.portais` without adding `lists` to the destructure from `useData()`.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: lists is not defined — line 79 uses `findColor(lists.portais, b.portal)` inside the Today Alerts (`todayBids.map`) but the component only destructures `{ summary, bids }` from useData() at line 33. When any bid has data_disputa === today (true in container date 2026-05-31 against seed data), the dashboard throws on render and the entire app is unusable.

integration_issues.issue: Because Dashboard is the default authenticated route and crashes, the entire app is blank after login. Direct navigation to /bids, /execution, /settings, and /orcamento/:id also failed to render any sidebar/content during this run (table count = 0, sidebar bg = null). New-bid modal, status dropdown, ERP page — none could be tested.

action_items: FIX (1 line): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx line 33, change `const { summary, bids } = useData();` to `const { summary, bids, lists } = useData();`. This restores the colored portal pill on the Today Alerts card and unblocks the whole app. After the fix, re-run the full smoke (login → dashboard → nav 4 screens → new-bid modal opens → status dropdown opens with colored options → ERP page renders the 21-col spreadsheet).
Consider wrapping the authenticated <Layout/> in an ErrorBoundary so a single page crash does not leave the entire app blank for end users.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: incomplete edit during the 'White-on-Ice' restyle. The change to render the Today Alerts portal as a vibrant colored pill required `lists.portais` to look up the configured color (via `findColor(lists.portais, b.portal)`), but the developer added the reference in JSX without updating the `useData()` destructure on line 33 (still only `{ summary, bids }`). Reproduction: log in as admin@licita.com/admin123 with at least one bid where data_disputa equals today (true with seeded data on 2026-05-31). The dashboard then enters the `todayBids.map(...)` branch and React throws `ReferenceError: lists is not defined`, killing the whole React tree. Mitigation: add `lists` to the destructure (`const { summary, bids, lists } = useData();`). Suggested defense-in-depth: add ErrorBoundary around the Layout/routes so a single screen crash doesn't blank the entire app.
